column1: # survey: Oklahoma Farm and Ranch Custom Rates, 2021-2022 (OSU Extension Current Report CR-205, revised March 2022)
# publisher: Oklahoma State University Extension, with the USDA NASS Oklahoma Field Office mailing
# collected: Survey of Oklahoma farmers, ranchers and custom operators, fall 2021; about 675 usable surveys
# includes: Custom work means the operator furnishes the implement, fuel, labor and other inputs tied to the job; seed or fertilizer only when stated.

# range_note: This report prints the average and the median, not a range. It is the newest Oklahoma edition we could find, from a 2021 survey, so it runs older than its neighbors. Rows with the state average withheld (D) are left out.
